card.name: Leading digit of a decimal or reference number
card.fires_on: A single digit that begins a number just before a decimal point or a dot, such as the 0 in 0.45 or the 2 in a section reference (2.4). Seen in data tables, PDB codes and bracketed section citations.

modes.label: Section references
modes.description: The first digit of a bracketed section number in label highlights, before the dot.
